lead: Practices that must keep patient data on their own machines buy the installed edition once. The licence does not expire; the optional maintenance contract does, and only updates stop with it.
note: Prices are net, per licence, paid once. Maintenance and updates are 18 % of the licence price per year and are optional. Austrian law applies; the licence is not transferable to another practice owner without our written agreement.

tiers.title: Einzelplatz
tiers.text: One workstation at one practice address, one practitioner. Includes the installer, the first year of updates and two hours of remote setup.

tiers.title: Praxislizenz
tiers.text: Up to five workstations at one address, unlimited practitioner accounts on those machines. Includes a test installation for training.

tiers.title: Verbundlizenz
tiers.text: Up to fifteen workstations across up to three addresses of the same practice owner, with a shared database on your own server.

tiers.title: Schullizenz
tiers.text: Teaching use at one campus with unlimited classroom seats and sample data only. Real patient data may not be entered under this licence.
